item.title: Group of AGs backs latest legal battle to defend Haitian TPS
item.description: New York Attorney General Letitia James has joined 17 states in urging a federal appeals court to preserve Temporary Protected Status for more than 350,000 Haitians. The post Group of AGs backs latest legal battle to defend Haitian TPS appeared first on The Haitian Times.

item.title: US offers $1M reward for Haitian gang leader Johnson “Izo” André
item.description: The $1 million reward targeting Izo— Haiti’s Village de Dieu gang leader— comes as kidnappings surge. A Feb. 18 U.S. security alert warned that ransom cases are increasing in Port-au-Prince, particularly in the Delmas area. The post US offers $1M reward for Haitian gang leader Johnson “Izo” André appeared first on The Haitian Times.

item.title: Haiti U-17 women draw United States in final round of 2026 FIFA World Cup qualifiers
item.description: Haiti’s U-17 women’s soccer team will face the United States, Puerto Rico and Bermuda in the final round of World Cup qualifying campaign. Les Petites Grenadières will face a tough battle to secure a berth at the Morocco 2026 tournament. item.title: Two sisters, 7 and 5, killed in La Gonâve, Haiti; police make arrests
item.description: Two young sisters were found dead in Kafoudèl, La Gonâve, after unknown individuals reportedly entered their home. Police have announced arrests, but authorities have not clarified whether the children were killed during a burglary or abducted and murdered elsewhere. item.title: UN report warns child trafficking by gangs threatens Haiti’s future
item.description: A UN report says most of Haiti’s 26 active gangs are trafficking children, exposing them to violence and exploitation while deepening the country’s security crisis. The post UN report warns child trafficking by gangs threatens Haiti’s future appeared first on The Haitian Times.
